item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.0

The first release: a Craft-style notes app for Mac, iPad and iPhone, built for code and machine-learning notes.

  • Block editor with live Markdown, slash commands, toggles, callouts and linked pages
  • Code blocks with syntax highlighting, LaTeX math and tables
  • Whiteboards powered by Excalidraw
  • Collections: tables, boards, galleries and lists inside a page
  • Spaces, folders, tags, starred pages and back/forward navigation
  • Tasks and a calendar of daily notes, with due dates synced to Apple Reminders or Todoist
  • AI writing with Claude (bring your own API key)
  • iCloud sync across your devices
